act: Consolidated Acts and Regulations of Canada (Justice Laws Website)

en.title: Justice Laws: in 2 regulations the English and French versions refer to different sections
en.summary: In 2 regulations of the consolidation, the English and French versions of a provision refer to different sections: Ozone-depleting Substances and Halocarbon Alternatives Regulations, subsection 54(2): English “allowance under section 55 or 61”, French “visée aux articles 55 ou 60”; Precursor Control Regulations, paragraph 85(7)(a): English “keep the report referred to in section 86.1”, French “conservent les rapports visés à l’article 86”. The origin of the differences has not been established: the original publications were not checked.
en.impact: Readers of the two language versions are sent to different provisions. Which version is right, and the effect on how the provision applies, were not assessed.
en.correction: Where the difference comes from the enacted or registered text, it needs an amendment by the responsible department; otherwise the consolidation can be corrected.

fr.title: Lois du Canada : dans 2 règlements, les versions anglaise et française renvoient à des articles différents
fr.summary: Règlement sur les substances appauvrissant la couche d’ozone et les halocarbures de remplacement, paragraphe 54(2) : version anglaise « allowance under section 55 or 61 », version française « visée aux articles 55 ou 60 ». Règlement sur les précurseurs, alinéa 85(7)a) : version anglaise « keep the report referred to in section 86.1 », version française « conservent les rapports visés à l’article 86 ». L’origine de ces écarts n’est pas établie : les publications originales n’ont pas été vérifiées.
